fact: On 7 July 2026 the Comité Scientifique Gabonais de Recherche sur l'Intelligence Artificielle (CSGR-IA) was received at the CESEC to explore regular involvement in its digital and innovation commissions, presenting its AI research such as Obone AI.
title: Institutions Consultatives : le CSGR-IA reçu en audience par le 2ème Vice-président du Conseil Économique, Social, Environnemental et Culturel (CESEC) Monsieur Geoffroy Foumboula Libeka Makosso
